method.mechanism: Capture the valid masked state after block 4 of the eight-block encoder. After the incumbent readout, add 0.1 times tanh of a zero-initialized, bias-free hidden-to-hidden projection of its L2-normalized captured state, scaled by sqrt(hidden). The generated control uses the same projection, initialization, scale, and mask on the final block state instead. This tests intermediate-feature access against extra readout capacity; ranking attribution remains provisional.
